line.description: Line of the record where it starts

principalIsDetail.description: True when the main decision is itself a detail of another

source.description: declared: read in compadr.feature and the glossary; proposed: computed from the relations and the cited code files

decisions.description: Every decision of the feature, the main one included

rules.description: Rules in force that a person validated, from features.yml

decision.description: Main decision whose chain was read

quote.description: Passage of the record, copied word for word

staleRecords.description: Records of the chain that changed, joined or left it since the validation of the rules; empty when they are current

featureProblems.description: Declarations of features that the engine left out, and why

target.description: Decision where the quote was found once, if any

section.description: Index in the sections of the target

location.description: Offsets of the rule in a section of the decision; null when it is elsewhere in the record

rulePolicy.description: rules.policy of compadr.yml, or its default

configProblems.description: Settings of compadr.yml left at their default, and why

assist.description: assist settings of compadr.yml, or their defaults

semantic.description: Whether compadr check --semantic may send the changes to the assist service

exclude.description: Paths whose changes never leave the repository: a file, or a folder and everything under it

zones.description: Folders of code and how much the decisions in force reach them

path.description: Folder of the zone; "." for the root

own.description: True when the subfolders of the folder are zones of their own: the zone then holds the files directly in the folder

linkedFiles.description: Files that a decision in force names: cited by its record, or citing it

crossChecked.description: Files that cite a decision whose record cites them too

weight.description: Sum of the weights of the links of the zone

decisions.description: Decisions in force linked to files of the zone, the heaviest first

folderCited.description: Decisions whose record cites the folder of the zone or one inside it, which says little about each file
